what: Phase 4: Export unified Obsidian vault containing both code nodes and persistent memories
why: Unify memories and codebase structure in a single browseable wiki.
learned: Querying graph_nodes and graph_edges from SQLite within ExportObsidian allows generating deep relative backlinks using a level-prefix calculator, without requiring OS-unsupported characters like colons in file paths.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: Obsidian export generates interconnected notes for memories, files, functions, classes, and packages. Test TestExportObsidian validates the link formatting.
next_steps: Handoff to user for final review and validation.
